verdict.rationale: First-party docs say Milvus Distributed is the official mode for running on a 'massive scale Kubernetes cluster serving billions of vectors in production', so Kubernetes production deployment is a documented, supported path. However, nothing in the evidence names an official Helm chart or Kubernetes operator, which is the specific mechanism the story asks about. Missing for 10: any evidence of an official Helm chart or operator, Kubernetes install/upgrade documentation, and independent hands-on corroboration of production Kubernetes deployments.
